department: Water Supply and Sewerage, Varanasi Nagar Nigam
description: VNN's published Citizen Charter states a specific new-water-connection timeline: within 15 days of applying, and the connection itself is given within 3 days of depositing the required amount, per the body's own published information.
procedure: Apply for a new water connection; the connection is provided within 3 days of depositing the required fee, per the 15-day overall processing window.
sla: Within 15 days of applying for a new water connection, the connection will be given within 3 days of depositing the desired amount.
expected_resolution_time: 15 days overall (3 days after fee deposit)
escalation_procedure: For unresolved complaints, the complainant informs the Additional Municipal Commissioner / Chief Municipal Commissioner.
escalation_authority: Additional Municipal Commissioner / Chief Municipal Commissioner

sub_service: General civic complaints via the standard VNN complaint format
problem_type: Uncollected garbage, potholes/damaged roads, non-working streetlights
description: VNN's Citizen Charter specifies a standard complaint format (complainant name, phone, ward number, zone number, complaint details) but does not publish category-specific SLAs for garbage, roads, or streetlight complaints -- only the water-connection timeline (see the separate water KnowledgeRecord) has a numeric figure. The same toll-free number and SMART KASHI APP serve all complaint types.
procedure: Submit a complaint via the SMART KASHI APP or toll-free helpline with your name, phone, ward number, and complaint details.
sla: SLA NOT FOUND for garbage/roads/streetlight complaints specifically.
complaint_channel: SMART KASHI APP (for complaints to Nagar Nigam or Jalkal)
escalation_procedure: For unresolved complaints, the complainant informs the Additional Municipal Commissioner / Chief Municipal Commissioner.
escalation_authority: Additional Municipal Commissioner / Chief Municipal Commissioner
